products.name: Chroma
products.note: Open-source embedding database; local-first; lightweight RAG; self-hosted option

reading.body:
Chroma is an open-source embedding database positioned for lightweight retrieval-augmented generation, with a local-first design and a self-hosted option.

The product is described as open-source search infrastructure for AI, built on Apache 2.0, and aimed at lightweight RAG. Local-first and self-hosted deployment can keep the software within a user's own environment, which matters for control and compliance, but the data does not state what compute, power, or building capacity that requires.

The available material includes no litigation, regulatory filings, or third-party records. It covers product positioning only, so it cannot support conclusions about scale, energy use, or data center footprint.

profile_text.body:
Chroma describes itself as open-source search infrastructure for AI. On its own site, the company says it brings the security, compliance, education and operational model that enterprises need, built on an Apache 2.0 architecture.

The company's product is also named Chroma. It is described as an open-source embedding database that is local-first, aimed at lightweight RAG, and available as a self-hosted option.

The available material does not include any litigation, regulatory filings, or other third-party records for the company.
